abort.already_configured: Alerts for this country (or state) are already set up.

user.title: Child abduction alert
user.description: Pick the country whose child abduction alerts (AMBER Alert and equivalents) you want to follow. Unofficial integration: if you have information, always call the number given in the alert.

data_description.country: Canada and the United States: official feeds. Other countries: the alert is detected in the headlines of at least two national media outlets.

region.title: State
region.description: Optional: limit alerts to one state. With a state picked, its media are also read, for alerts the National Weather Service does not relay.
